children.name: Viridantha minuscula Hern.-Cárdenas, Espejo & López-Ferr.
children.description: Plants saxicolous, flowering 6 – 8 cm tall, 7 – 8 cm in diameter; rosettes short caulescent, irregular in outline, forming clumps of many rosettes. Leaves 13 – 16, shorter than or equal to the inflorescence; sheath yellow green, pale brown when dry on both surfaces, very widely ovate, 8 – 10 mm long, 8 – 10 mm wide, glabrous at the base and lepidote distally on both surfaces; blade densely grey lepidote, very narrowly triangular, 4 – 5 cm long, 3 – 4 mm wide, attenuate, divaricate to ascending.
